ai_summary: Euro Panel Products Limited (EUROBOND) demonstrated strong operational momentum in Q2 FY27, reporting robust net sales growth of 17.15% YoY and an impressive 27% sequentially to ₹152.13 crore, primarily driven by a 22.68% increase in panel sales volume. The company posted a Profit Before Tax (PBT) of ₹6.83 crores, reflecting healthy demand from infrastructure and commercial construction sectors. However, the release notably omits net profit figures and comparative PBT data, limiting a comprehensive assessment of overall profitability and financial efficiency.
